summary: A paper worker asks whether a checkout rule will actually bring the mill any customers.
realLife: Washington House report on ESSB 5323, 2020. House Finance testimony pointed out that permitting paper bags did not require stores to offer them.
inGame: needs: a proposal permits paper and a mill is forecasting sales.
gates: A proposal permits paper and a mill is forecasting sales.

turns.what: A buyer signs for the mill's paper.
turns.pulledBy: A chain signs a paper supply agreement.
turns.writesBack: The mill adds the order to its production schedule.

turns.what: The mill calls its sales estimate back for review.
turns.pulledBy: Shoppers bring their own bags and the chain places no order.
turns.writesBack: The mill revises the forecast using actual purchases.
